subject: Preferred billing path and example invoice rows — portal first, email contingency
messages:
From: Amira Khan <amira.k@pinebridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: PineBridge Logistics Billing <billing@pinebridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission and sample rows attached

Hi Stephanie / Jordan,

Thanks for taking our call last week. Per the onboarding checklist we want to confirm the best way to send invoices to Redwood. Our AP team prefers to use a vendor portal but we can also send invoices by email if that is simpler.

Attached is a quick sample CSV (pinebridge_sample_invoice_202805.csv) that mirrors how our ERP exports line items. A few questions up front:
- Do you require PO numbers on the invoice header, or is embedding PO per line acceptable?
- What acknowledgement headers or subject tokens do you need so your system auto-acknowledges receipt? (we currently send: Subject: Invoice | VendorID | Invoice#)
- Are there any mandatory column names or formats we should follow for line items and tax fields?

We'd like to avoid manual processing where possible — if the portal gives better SLAs, happy to onboard. If email is acceptable as a short-term fallback, please outline the minimal required fields so our team can export accordingly.

Thanks,
Amira Khan
Billing Operations Manager
PineBridge Logistics
amira.k@pinebridge.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: pinebridge_sample_invoice_202805.csv (CSV, 2KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission and sample rows attached

Hi Amira — great to meet you on the call. Short answers below and a couple of examples.

TL;DR: Portal is preferred for production (faster ACKs, automatic PO matching, idempotency). Email is supported as an interim fallback if you add a minimal subject token and the CSV columns below.

Portal benefits (why we recommend it):
- Instant ACK and ingestion trace (shown in vendor portal)
- Automatic PO-to-invoice matching and line-level PO support
- Deduplication using Invoice Number + VendorID

If you must email, please follow these minimal requirements so our ingestion engine can process without manual touch:
- Subject: INVOICE | Redwood-VendorID:<vendor_id> | INV:<invoice_number>
- Required header columns in CSV: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate(YYYY-MM-DD), VendorID, Currency, TotalAmount, LineDescription, LineAmount, PO_Number (leave blank if none), TaxAmount, TaxCode
- If multiple POs are present on one invoice, include a PO_Number column per line and sum to the header TotalAmount.

Sample header row (CSV):
InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,VendorID,Currency,TotalAmount,LineDescription,LineAmount,PO_Number,TaxAmount,TaxCode
INV-20280511,2028-05-11,PINEB-223,USD,3120.00,Freight to SF,300.00,PO-889,0.00,SHIP
INV-20280511,2028-05-11,PINEB-223,USD,3120.00,Storage May,2820.00,PO-890,0.00,SVC

ACK SLA: portal = immediate; email = within 8 business hours if subject token present and file format valid. Missing token or malformed CSV will create a processing ticket and may take 2+ business days.

We've uploaded a short mapping doc to Drive (link below) that shows field-level expectations and examples. If you want, we can kick off a brief mapping call this week and accept a single test invoice via email to validate.

Drive mapping: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_sample_map
HubSpot: 4589-PR (onboarding playbook)

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Procurement Onboarding
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(650) 555-0114
From: Amira Khan <amira.k@pinebridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: PineBridge Logistics Billing <billing@pinebridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission and sample rows attached

Thanks, Stephanie — that helps a lot. We updated the CSV to include PO_Number per line and added the subject token in our outbound rule. Attaching updated sample (pinebridge_sample_invoice_202805.csv).

A couple of clarification points:
1) Our ERP sometimes aggregates multiple POs on a single invoice. You note per-line PO is preferred — if we include multiple lines with different PO_Number values that total the header amount, is that acceptable for automated matching?
2) Do you require a separate TaxTotal header column, or is summing TaxAmount per line OK?
3) For the email fallback, will BCCing billing@redwood.com create an ingestion ticket or should it be To: accounts-payable@redwood.com?

Example subject we will send: "INVOICE | Redwood-VendorID:PINEB-223 | INV:INV-20280511"

If the test looks good, we'll schedule portal onboarding next week.

—Amira

Attachment: pinebridge_sample_invoice_202805.csv (CSV, 2KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission and sample rows attached (internal)

Jordan / Rishi — FYI the vendor updated the CSV and will send a test using the subject token. Internal notes:
- Our ingestion pipeline can match multiple PO_Number values per invoice as long as the per-line PO_Number is present and sums reconcile to the header TotalAmount. We should document this explicitly in the onboarding form (step 3).
- Make the email fallback acknowledgement SLA 8 business hours and include the exact subject token example in the form.
- Rishi: can you add a pre-check in the intake lambda to surface mismatched totals back to vendor before creating a ticket? That will cut manual queues.

I will send the test criteria to Amira after you confirm the pre-check timeline.

Thanks,
Stephanie
